environment.description: ECS Fargate service behind Amazon API Gateway (REST API) with request validation enabled. The API Gateway resource has a request validator of type 'Validate body, query string parameters, and headers' attached to each method. The API model schema for GET /api/v1/proxy/fetch defines the 'url' query parameter with a regex pattern constraint: "^https://[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\.]+\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}(/[a-zA-Z0-9\\-._~:/?#\\[\\]@!$&'()*+,;=%]*)?$". The POST /api/v1/webhooks/register model schema constrains 'callback_url' with the same pattern. The GET /api/v1/oauth/callback schema constrains 'return_url' to match "^/[a-zA-Z0-9/\\-_]*$" (relative paths only). Request validation failures return 400 before reaching the backend integration. The API Gateway uses a VPC Link to the internal NLB which forwards to the Fargate service. Additionally, the Fargate task's security group restricts egress to only port 443 outbound to a prefix list for the VPC endpoints and the internal service discovery namespace on port 8080.

config.networking: awsvpc mode, private subnet, no NAT gateway
config.api_gateway: REST API with request validators on all methods
config.request_validation: Validate body, query string parameters, and headers
config.security_group_egress: 443 to com.amazonaws.*.s3 and com.amazonaws.*.secretsmanager prefix lists; 8080 to service discovery namespace CIDR
